name: Sprint 2: OAuth2 and Password Management
goal: Implement OAuth2 authentication and password reset functionality to enable users to login with third-party providers and recover their accounts

notes: OAuth2 integration requires environment variables for client IDs and secrets
Email service needs to be configured before password reset can be tested
User profile endpoints depend on completed JWT implementation from Sprint 1

technicalDecisions.reasoning: Industry standard with good documentation and community support
Free tier available, reliable delivery, good API
